concepts.label: cbstats
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - already promoted; the tool:cbstats registry note itself names 'collection change-history status (collections-details)' as one of the three things this tool surfaces that the Web Console does not

concepts.label: default collection
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - already promoted; the page's example output identifies the first collection returned by name as '_default'

concepts.label: Collections manifest (manifest_uid)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - a real, page-stated versioning mechanism ('the manifest_uid value is associated with the current state of collections on the node') distinct from any individual stat field; nothing in the registry currently names this mechanism

concepts.label: Collection change history
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the mechanism-level feature behind the collection's history stat field (true/false, Magma-gated); mint at the feature level, not the field level, per this round's canonical-table warning

relations.subject: server:scope
relations.evidence: The `scope_name` line identifies the scope within which this collection resides: in this case, the scope is the `_default` scope.

relations.subject: server:collection-change-history
relations.evidence: the value can only be `true` when _Magma_ has been configured as the storage engine for the bucket

relations.subject: server:collection-change-history
relations.evidence: The `history` line indicates whether a _change history_ is made for the collection: `true` indicates that a change history is being made, and `false` indicates that it is not.

relations.subject: server:collections-manifest
relations.evidence: The `manifest_uid` value is associated with the current state of collections on the node; and will be incremented whenever a collections-related change is made.

notable_absence.finding: Every example on the page runs with '-u Administrator -p password', but the page never states which specific privilege or RBAC role is actually required to run `cbstats collections` - credential requirements are shown by example only, never stated as a rule, unlike many other Server reference pages that name a specific role.

cross_component_finding: The `metered` line's description - 'The metered line is not used in Couchbase Server Version 7.6, and always has the value 0' - is a stale, version-pinned sentence (name-checking 7.6 specifically) that recurs verbatim on the sibling cbstats-collections-details.md page as well, despite both pages being served here as 8.0 reference material. This is prose-level copy-paste evidence between the base/-details pair, even though the underlying stat data each page returns (collection-level totals here vs. per-vBucket breakdowns on -details) is genuinely different in depth, not redundant.
cross_product_finding: capella:collection and capella:scope (documented extensively elsewhere in the corpus) have no analog for server:collections-manifest or server:collection-change-history: Capella exposes scopes/collections purely through UI/REST, with no manifest-versioning or Magma-gated change-history concept ever described on that surface.
